servinfo.title: Cooling System Refilling
servinfo.ptxt: Before performing the following procedure, observe Precautions for Cooling System:K14D .

s1.ptxt: Fill degassing tank (1) with coolant up to “FULL” mark (2).
Loosen drain cock plug (1) on the radiator.
Fill degassing tank with coolant until coolant comes out from drain cock plug, and then install drain cock plug.
Fill degassing tank with coolant up to “FULL” mark and install degassing tank cap.
Run engine at idle speed until radiator fan motor is operated.
Stop engine and wait until engine cools down to avoid getting burned.
Add coolant to degassing tank up to “FULL” mark and install degassing tank cap.
Check that coolant level in degassing tank is at “FULL” mark. If coolant is insufficient, add coolant.
